All 86 were probed against the pre-existing suite at commit (79 killed); the 7 survivors were re-probed with the new tests. Equivalent: E56 (step 1 multiplies 1e50 or 10^0.5 1e50, and neither product borrows), E52 (exhaustive modular search over all 65536 step results and every series value finds no carry in the final multiply), E115 (the series at x = 2^-16 floors to exactly the last step's constant, checked for all 32768 prefixes).
